items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Big Chief Moore) does not speak in the provided context. The mention of Claude Luter is made by the Interviewer, who states Luter was 'using Claude Luter' in Sidney Bechet's group. There is no evidence in the transcript that Big Chief Moore personally knew, met, or collaborated with

ctx.x: Oh, no, that's too bad. I didn't know that. But he was the piano player there at the Festival and Bechet had his group, he was using Claude Luter and Luter had his band intact. So there was no American musicians with Bechet at this Festival.
